status: Science confirmed; mechanical preflight and combined gate pending

findings.finding: Gain-one recurrence is not the exact finite-beta Cartesian mean derivative.
findings.resolution: Declare supplied linear comparator; derive sphere mean derivative A(n beta)/n separately from aligned noise variance. Historical simulations do not prove limits or physical laws.

findings.finding: False non-product proof and missing conjugation in complex covariance.
findings.resolution: Static Green kernel also equals plane amplitude times layer propagator; replace proof with exact recurrence and distinguish linear versus quadratic wavenumber decay. Add complex L4 phase check; state oblique coordinates and explicit symmetry subgroup.

findings.finding: Mode independence, variance-as-transient-time, universal lattice-sum increments and nonlinear scaling claims unsupported.
findings.resolution: Temporal noise independence suffices; define exact proxy and spectral transient. Restrict increments to16,32,64; derive log2 interval; preserve historical data without asymptotic conclusions.

findings.finding: Uniqueness assumptions absent, component independence overstated, reflection halves wrong and source zero mode unprojected.
findings.resolution: Positive site selection and bounded sphere or finite alphabet minorization; factorized initial data for independence; correct bilayer-layer halves; project mean and exclude staggered pole. Import only scalar bound from current cubic-walk parent.

findings.finding: Unlanded equivalence dependency, box-support gap, antichain factorization and same-level displacement errors.
findings.resolution: Self-contained counterexample, causal ancestry excludes negative coordinates; fixed read sets and explicitly factorized joint kernel; zero coordinate-sum displacement; exact table/control assertions.

findings.finding: Finite samples substituted for proofs, rational/Haar domain mismatch, parity-rule prose mismatch and overbroad locality conclusions.
findings.resolution: Real-sphere analytic domain with rational controls; orbit/infinite-order proofs and exact census. Last-site parity rule plus general per-order uniformity proof. Verify all512 dual characters and LR formed-neighbour conditional; scope exclusions to supplied conditionals.

findings.finding: Unproved spectral limits and insufficient requested levels for multiplicity; silent symmetrization.
findings.resolution: Finite estimates only, seeded solvers, symmetry/residual checks and levels beyond cluster; independent exact small transfer contractions.

findings.finding: Original campaign state, historical certificates and weak scope/cache coverage.
findings.resolution: Canonical science only; fresh caches and consequential mutations; five AIL branches preserved for deferred auxiliary calculations. No audit verdict.

coverage: All10 canonical runners and retained premise/proof surfaces read; shared AIL boilerplate structurally compared and changed functions read. Independent exact sphere derivative, Green recurrence and complex phase; integer transfer contractions; five binary optimization minima with exact witnesses; full-pattern sums/all-order products at two weight triples; Burnside census;120 new orders with512 coin vectors each; bilayer reflections. Ten consequential science mutations caught. Historical auxiliary programs are explicitly deferred and preserved, not certified or freshly executed.
